item.title: Multi-Cluster Applications Under Kubevela
item.description: Kubevela is currently at version 1.1. We usually consider 1.x releases to be relatively stable and safe to try in production. Through continuous tracking and learning, I have also come to appreciate some of the things Kubevela does well. This is a summary document. 1. What Problem Kubevela Solves Aimed at platform developers Several roles need to be distinguished: development, operations, and operations development.
